However, because it's Nero, he manages to turn a fight for "Equal Rights" into a self-centered campaign for "Actor’s Rights."

programme.title: High Is Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: The title is a classic Nero-ism—a mangled version of "All's Well That Ends Well," infused with his obsession with "vibrations" and high-frequency living. In this finale, Nero is faced with the ultimate test: a real, high-stakes opportunity that requires him to be... normal.

programme.title: All's Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: The documentary crew follows a rare moment of "crisis" in Nero’s life. His landlord has had enough of the "acting workshops" (noise) and unpaid dues. Nero, however, refuses to see this as a tragedy; he views it as the "Second Act" of his biopic where the hero hits rock bottom before the inevitable rise.

programme.title: Respawn
programme.desc: Arun (Vishal Vashishtha) is a former professional gamer, once known as "Flickshot," who left his passion to work a monotonous corporate job and support his family. When he sees his former teammate, Shekhar, succeeding on a massive stage, his suppressed passion resurfaces. Despite his father’s disapproval and the general stigma surrounding gaming as a career, Arun decides to quit his job and attempt a comeback.

programme.title: A New Beginning
programme.desc: Arun realizes he can’t win alone and begins the hunt for a new team. The episode focuses on the recruitment of a "misfit" squad: Prachi: A badminton player struggling with an injury. Jeetu: A delivery boy with natural, lightning-fast reflexes. Adil: A young, tech-savvy enthusiast who acts as the team's initial bridge. Raunak: A volatile but highly skilled "fragger." The task is harder than Arun anticipated, as he has to convince these individuals (and their skeptical families) that they have what it takes to be pros.99999999999

programme.title: Noobde (noobs)
programme.desc: The team has assembled, but the chemistry is non-existent. Raunak’s ego clashes with the other members, and the group struggles to put their personal issues aside during practice. Arun has to step up not just as a player, but as a coach, to teach them that in Esports, individual brilliance is useless without team synergy. This episode highlights the "grind" of professional gaming and the steep learning curve.

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: With the tournament only a week away, the pressure reaches a boiling point. Arun’s father discovers he quit his job, leading to a major confrontation. Meanwhile, the team faces a crushing defeat in a practice match against established professionals, leaving their confidence shattered. However, seeing Arun's dedication eventually inspires his father to have a change of heart, and the team finally begins to gel as a unit.

programme.title: Rise Of The Underdogs
programme.desc: The season finale takes place at the Indian Pro Gaming League. Team Clutch enters as the ultimate underdogs. After a shaky start and a brief internal conflict where Raunak almost walks out, the team reunites for a final stand. They reach a thrilling tie-breaker round where they must prove their worth. The series ends with the team securing a victory, using their prize money to chase their individual dreams while planning to build a permanent gaming headquarters.

programme.title: Rangbaaji (the Carefree Persona)
programme.desc: We are introduced to Raviranjan, a small-town guy who balances life as a part-time YouTuber with his status as a "full-time" aspirant. While he acts confident (his rangbaaji), the episode reveals the underlying pressure he faces. He isn’t just seeking a job; he’s seeking the social status required to marry Jyoti. The episode sets up the stakes: it's a battle between his dreams and the harsh deadlines of the competitive exam world.

programme.title: Parishram (the Effort)
programme.desc: The reality check hits hard when the OSC results are announced and Ravi fails his first attempt. He faces taunts from his family and the crushing weight of societal judgment. Encouraged by Jyoti, who provides both emotional support and a strategic plan, Ravi moves from being a "casual" student to a "hardcore" aspirant. This episode highlights the physical and mental "grind" involved in the preparation.

programme.title: Avroh (the Descent)
programme.desc: As the wait for the next exam cycle continues, the "high" of hard work starts to fade into a "low" (Avroh means descent). Financial struggles, family tensions, and unexpected "villains" in the form of societal gatekeepers threaten to derail him. Ravi is forced to make difficult choices between his relationship with Jyoti and his focus on the exam, as the cracks in his mental health begin to show.

programme.title: Prateeksha (the Finale The Wait)
programme.desc: The finale focuses on the most agonizing part of the process: the wait. Ravi faces his final hurdles and a major internal crisis of self-doubt. The episode serves as a powerful commentary on the Indian examination system, exploring whether a job title truly defines a person's worth. It concludes Raviranjan's journey by showing how he manages to reclaim his self-respect (Swabhiman), regardless of the exam result.

programme.title: Humse Na Ho Paayega
programme.desc: The episode sets the stage for the ultimate "Generation Gap" social experiment. Akash (Rohan Shah) and Pooja (Aditi Myakal) are a modern married couple living in a spacious Mumbai apartment. However, their lifestyle is outpacing their income, leading them to a radical decision: renting out their spare rooms to bachelors.

programme.title: Khan-Daan
programme.desc: After the initial adjustment period of the pilot, the household faces its first major logistical crisis—Food. The episode explores the chaos of shared groceries, differing diets, and the "disaster" that is a communal refrigerator.

programme.title: Safai-Squad
programme.desc: After weeks of living together, the apartment has reached a state of "critical mess." Aashna (Kriti Vij), who takes pride in a clean and aesthetic home, finally snaps. The episode follows the couple's attempt to militarize the house cleaning process and the bachelors' hilariously lazy resistance.

programme.title: Family Ban Gayi
programme.desc: The episode begins with a sense of impending change. After weeks of chaos, the experimental living arrangement—where a married couple (Akash and Pooja) shares their home with three bachelors (Rohit, Mohit, and Vishi)—is put to the test.

programme.title: Hotel California
programme.desc: Maya, a Gen Z UX designer, joins Thoda Sukoon — a mental health startup with strict office hours, long workdays, and zero breathing space. Expecting flexibility and support, she instead finds herself caught in a whirlwind of deadlines and old-school hustle. As pressure mounts ahead of a major product launch and funding round, Maya connects with her burnt-out teammates. But when it comes to challenging the system — who’s willing to speak up?

programme.title: The Launch
programme.desc: Tight deadlines. Zero chill. And one very fed-up Maya. Maya’s ideas get ghosted, her dedication’s under the scanner, and the team? Busy minding their own burnout. Just when she finds a bit of empathy, things spiral again. Sleep is a myth, pressure is real, and Maya’s had enough. But when push comes to shove… does she stay, or finally hit CTRL+ALT+ESC?

programme.title: All Is Well
programme.desc: Maya’s impulsive decision leaves her awkward around Chirag, who doesn’t miss a chance to tease her. As they open up about their generational views on work and life, Maya reaffirms her belief in mental health and Thoda Sukoon’s mission. But just as things start looking up, a bold move in a high-stakes meeting sparks serious tension with the higher-ups. Can Maya recover when her values put her at odds with the very system she’s trying to change?

programme.title: The Breakdown
programme.desc: While the team scrambles to fix minor app bugs, the real issues at Thoda Sukoon are swept under the rug — until it all explodes. An employee collapses from overwork, triggering a full-blown social media backlash. As tensions rise, Maya and Chirag are forced to face unresolved conflict, and the team must ask: how far is too far? Can this crisis spark real change in a toxic work culture, or is it already too late?

programme.title: The Cliffhanger
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Riddhi's collapse, Zooni spearheads a desperate negotiation for better working conditions. As a seemingly balanced work environment emerges, the team struggles to deliver, and blurred lines between professional and personal lives begin to fray. Are these simply growing pains for Thoda Sukoon, or are fresh, explosive complications on the horizon?

programme.title: The Misfit
programme.desc: India’s fashion matriarch, Zahira, is making a bold move - bringing Zahiraan into the world of wearable luxury. But there’s a catch - neither she nor her team knows how to navigate this shift. Thus, comes in Ayesha - a rookie designer, a dreamer bursting with fresh ideas. But will she survive the cut-throat competition in fashion and at Zahiraan? Get ready for an intense drama, glamorous showdowns, and career-defining moments as the battle for success begins at Zahiraan.

programme.title: Time To Shine
programme.desc: Ayesha’s out-of-the-box ideas leave a mark on Zahira, but not everyone is impressed. As she tries to navigate the high-pressure world of fashion, her bold creativity ignites a war with her team. Amidst the chaos, an unexpected friendship with Sanchi gives Ayesha the confidence boost she desperately needs. But in an industry where talent isn’t enough, will this newfound support be her key to a major breakthrough?

programme.title: The Big Launch
programme.desc: The much-awaited Zahiraan launch is here, but disaster strikes! One unexpected error threatens to crumble Ayesha's hard-won validation from Zahira, and jeopardize both their careers. Meanwhile, Karan battles crippling self-doubt, wondering if he'll ever measure up to the perfection demanded by the high-stakes fashion world. Will their reputations survive?

programme.title: Perfect Shaadi
programme.desc: Aditya and Prajakta are all set to tie the knot! As they navigate the excitement and chaos of wedding planning, a surprise guest from Prajakta's past arrives, turning their perfect day upside down. Will love triumph over unexpected challenges?

programme.title: Basundi Ki Bhasudi
programme.desc: As Aditya and Prajakta celebrate their pre-wedding festivities, a shocking twist turns their world upside down! Will they handle the chaos together?

programme.title: Hum Tum Aur?
programme.desc: A perfect wedding, a hidden secret, and a love under threat. Will Aditya and Prajakta's love story survive the test of time?

programme.title: Bride Ka Best Man
programme.desc: As pre-wedding festivities unfold, Aditya stumbles upon a secret only Prajakta’s best friend knew. Can he handle the parts of her he’s just beginning to see?

programme.title: Imperfect Shaadi
programme.desc: The episode centers on the wedding of the lead couple, where everything seemingly goes wrong. However, instead of letting the chaos ruin the day, the couple realizes that the "imperfections" of their wedding reflect the reality of their relationship. They choose to embrace the mess, focusing on their commitment to each other.

programme.title: Infection
programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.title: Diagnosis
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Complications
programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.title: Surgery
programme.desc: Huma faces a crisis of confidence, seeking unconventional advice to regain her footing. A heartbreaking event forces the friends to reevaluate their priorities and the strength of their bond.

programme.title: Recovery
programme.desc: As final exams approach, Huma contemplates unethical shortcuts, leading to revelations that challenge perceptions and test the integrity of their friendship.

programme.title: Honeymoon Period
programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.title: Donning
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Patient Zero
programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.title: Lockdown
programme.desc: Huma faces a crisis of confidence, seeking unconventional advice to regain her footing. A heartbreaking event forces the friends to reevaluate their priorities and the strength of their bond.

programme.title: Critical Condition
programme.desc: As final exams approach, Huma contemplates unethical shortcuts, leading to revelations that challenge perceptions and test the integrity of their friendship.

programme.title: Fomo
programme.desc: Dhruv and Kavya plan a lazy Sunday but feel the pressure of missing out when they see their friends enjoying exciting activities on social media. This leads them to seek ways to spice up their day.

programme.title: Have A Nice Day
programme.desc: A morning rush to work results in a tussle between Dhruv and Kavya, spoiling their moods. Throughout the day, they attempt to make amends, highlighting the irony and sweetness of their relationship.

programme.title: Good Night
programme.desc: A sleepless night due to mosquitoes leads to the discovery that Kavya's ex-boyfriend is getting married, prompting a long conversation about their past relationships.

programme.title: Thank You!
programme.desc: Plans for a dinner at an Iranian restaurant get canceled, leading Dhruv and Kavya to attend a friend's house party. The night evolves into an unexpected adventure, ending at a local fair.

programme.title: Here We Go!
programme.desc: During a visit to a vineyard, Dhruv and Kavya open up about their insecurities and future aspirations, leading to deeper conversations about life and their relationship.

programme.title: Masterji
programme.desc: Kishore, an orphan has only one dream, to join the IndianArmy. When he gets thrown out of his orphanage, Masterji, an ex-army officer who left the army and is now working as a tailor, reluctantly adopts him. The khadoos Masterji and Kishore have only two things in common, their dream to serve the nation and their lonely lives. Will Masterji help Kishore achieve his own unfulfilled dreams to become a soldier, and will Kishore find a father in Masterji?

programme.title: Jaldi Lautna, Captain
programme.desc: Captain Vikrant Sahay and his wife Vibha had a beautiful love story. But Vikrant’s sudden death in battle leaves the otherwise happy-go-lucky Vibha completely shocked. Unable to deal with Vikrant’s death, Vibha decides that the best way to honor him is to fulfill his dream, by joining the army herself, much against her family’s wishes. Will Vibha succeed and make her late husband, her family, and the country proud?

programme.title: Shooter Jawan
programme.desc: Tribhuvan, a dedicated Indian Army Officer comes across a young sweeper Tinku, who is a gifted shooter. Tribhuvan knows Tinku has a rare talent, and wants to enroll him in the shooting academy and then the Indian Army. However, owing to Tinku’s caste, his father is afraid of society’s taunts and is completely against this career choice. Will Tinku have the courage to fight back and rise above ‘log kya kahenge’?

programme.title: Sarhad Ke Baad Bhi
programme.desc: Colonel Balram, a retired Indian Army Officer, returns home after several years of service, only to find himself completely disconnected from his son Aman. While Balram is failing at mending his relationship with Aman, he is also silently struggling with mental health issues, because of his days at war. Will Aman ever understand his father’s sacrifices for the country or will it be too late before he realises just how much his father loves him?

programme.title: Veera
programme.desc: Veera’s martyred father’s last wish was for her to join the Indian armed forces. But Veera is not for it. The bravery and patriotism that the country remembers and celebrates him for, are the same things that took Veera’s father away from her. She’s been carrying this anger and hurt in her heart for too long, until she discovers a hidden letter.

programme.title: Bachelorhood
programme.desc: Viraj and Arjun have been best friends since childhood. While Viraj loves his bachelor life and wants Arjun to move in as his flatmate, Arjun has other plans of ‘settling down’. What happens when this bachelor reveals he wants to be ‘unbachelored?’

programme.title: Kabab Mein Haddi
programme.desc: The gang gets together to celebrate Arjun’s big news, but Viraj is concerned whether the dynamics of the group will change with its new addition. Will Khushi win over the gang and get Viraj's stamp of approval?

programme.title: (un)happy Birthday
programme.desc: Its Arjun’s birthday, and Khushi steals the limelight with her unconventional celebration party. Tensions at the party rise when Viraj confronts Arjun about his change in behaviour since he started dating Khushi. Will Arjun pick pyaar or dosti?

programme.title: Mann Ki Rant
programme.desc: The group tries to resolve tensions between Viraj and Arjun, but they both resist. As Viraj rants to Zara and Kaka about his friendships and relationships, he realises more about his true self.

programme.title: Yaar Ki Shaadi
programme.desc: The wedding day is here! Will Viraj stand by Arjun on the most important day of his life, and will he admit his true feelings to a special someone?

programme.title: Conflict Of Interest
programme.desc: Shagun wants to keep the Filmy Weddings business floating and for that she’s willing to go to any lengths. Even if it means shooting a wedding film for Adhira’s ex-boyfriend – Akhil. Adhira is furious and tries her best to sabotage the entire project. Unfortunately, her one big hurdle is Dad, who has taken quite a fondness for Akhil. Check out the episode and find out what happens next!

programme.title: Internal Politics
programme.desc: Adhira and Shagun are in a disagreement about whom to select for a wedding film promo: a boring aunt from the bride's side or a lively drunk aunt from the groom's family. Things take a turn for the complicated when the parents also weigh in with their respective biases.

programme.title: Poaching The Talent
programme.desc: Vishnu, the Agarwal's househelp cum man friday is desired by the sisters as an office boy to help them sort out their business affairs. The parents are naturally opposed to the idea. Thus begins another standoff in the Agarwal household - and Vishnu's position in the house is at stake. Who will finally lay claim over Vishnu's priceless services?

programme.title: Business Secrets
programme.desc: In a footage from a wedding they just filmed, the sisters find a drunken confession from the bride's best friend. It turns out she is the groom's ex - and he hasn't told the bride to be. Caught in the moral dilemma of choosing to tell the bride or not, the sisters find themselves on other ends of the argument. Meanwhile, it is revealed that Adhira's father might have a similar secret hidden from everyone. Will the sisters do the morally right thing or the financially right thing? And what is the father's bizarre obsession with knowing who the groom's mom is?

programme.title: Breach Of Contract
programme.desc: Chasing a competitive business pitch to work for a coveted fashion firm, the sisters are again at different sides of a dilemma. The commitment to the new opportunity would be for a minimum two years, which Adhira is reluctant to make at the age of 25. Whereas Shagun, having already quit her high paying corporate job to join this business, sees no harm in seizing the opportunity with open arms. As their argument turns to a fight, we are left wondering if this is in fact the fight to end all fights. Will the sisters come to the same page and work for the pitch? Or will Happily Hitched disband for good?

programme.title: Arranged Family
programme.desc: Nikhil Solanki arrives at his in-laws' home, where a series of mishaps culminate in a significant blunder that upsets his father-in-law, Prakash Sharma. Both struggle to address the situation openly.

programme.title: The Mad House
programme.desc: Prakash avoids acknowledging that Nikhil damaged his car, instead blaming neighborhood children. Nikhil's attempts to rectify the situation lead to further complications.

programme.title: Conditions Apply
programme.desc: During Sudha and Prakash's anniversary celebration, relatives pose uncomfortable questions, challenging Nikhil's patience and composure.

programme.title: Stuck In The Middle
programme.desc: A disagreement between Anita and her parents results in a cold war, leaving Nikhil caught between his wife and in-laws.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Nikhil expresses his feelings of being an outsider within the family, prompting an open discussion aimed at resolving underlying issues.

programme.title: Welcome Home
programme.desc: A few months after moving to Mumbai, Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita are finally settled. The peace is interrupted by the arrival of Nikhil's parents, Kiran (Shishir Sharma) and Vandana (Renuka Shahane), for a short visit. Anita, ever the perfectionist, is anxious to be the "perfect daughter-in-law," but her efforts are met with a series of awkward and hilarious hurdles.

programme.title: Surprise, Surprise!
programme.desc: The episode picks up with the fallout of Nikhil’s father, Kiran (Shishir Sharma), going missing during his walk in the previous episode. While he eventually returns, the tension doesn't dissipate. The "surprise" of the title is twofold: the unexpected arrival of Nikhil’s sister, Shreya (Kriti Vij), and the unsettling realization that something is physically or mentally "off" with Kiran.

programme.title: Spilling The Beans
programme.desc: The entire family—Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh), Anita (Eisha Chopra), Kiran (Shishir Sharma), Vandana (Renuka Shahane), and Shreya (Kriti Vij)—piles into a car to attend a relative's 60th birthday celebration. What was meant to be a joyful getaway becomes a pressure cooker for the long-standing resentment between the siblings.

programme.title: Something's Missing
programme.desc: The title is a poignant double entendre: it refers to a missing set of rings at the family function, but more deeply, it refers to the "missing" pieces of Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) memory. The facade of a "normal family vacation" finally crumbles, forcing the Solankis to stop pretending.

programme.title: House Of Cards
programme.desc: The title "House of Cards" refers to the fragile "perfect family" image the Solankis have tried to maintain. After the emotional explosion regarding Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health and Shreya’s (Kriti Vij) marriage, the "house" has finally collapsed—but in its place, something more honest is being built.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: In the Season 2 finale, "Home," Anita and Nikhil prepare to move into their own place. The episode resolves the season's friction between Anita and her mother-in-law, replacing awkward formalities with genuine mutual respect. As they move out, the story concludes that "home" isn't about physical space, but the emotional bridge built between two different generations.

programme.title: Circle Of Life
programme.desc: The title "Circle of Life" refers to the poignant role reversal where the children now become the guardians of their parents, mirroring the care they once received.

programme.title: Not Kidding
programme.desc: The episode centers on a visit from Anita’s boisterous, unfiltered parents—Akshata (Deepika Amin) and Kiran Sharma (Shishir Sharma). The quiet, disciplined, and currently somber Solanki household is suddenly upended by the high-energy Sharmas. The primary conflict arises when the two sets of parents have a "polite clash" over how to care for the ailing Kiran Solanki and, more pivotally, the couple's future plans regarding children.

programme.title: Here We Go Again
programme.desc: With the house now fully "merged," Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) decide to throw a surprise anniversary party for the "Folks." While their intentions are pure, the episode explores how a "celebration" can quickly become a source of stress when dealing with a chronic illness and interfering relatives.

programme.title: Zor Se Bolo
programme.desc: The episode revolves around a chaotic Sunday at the Solanki household. The central plot involves Kiran Solanki (Shishir Sharma) needing a hearing aid, but it quickly spirals into a larger commentary on how the family members are "deaf" to each other's actual needs and desires.

programme.title: That's All Folks
programme.desc: The finale moves away from the day-to-day bickering and centers on a quiet realization: Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Eisha Chopra) have finally stopped "adjusting" and have started living. The episode focuses on the family accepting their "New Normal" while acknowledging that the road ahead with Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health will be challenging but shared.

programme.title: Truth Bombs
programme.desc: The episode begins with Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Esha Chopra) gathering the family for a "serious talk." After months of private deliberation, they drop the ultimate truth bomb: they have decided to adopt a child instead of pursuing a biological pregnancy.

programme.title: The Damaad Test
programme.desc: The episode centers on the Home Study, a critical step in the Indian adoption process where a government social worker visits the family to determine if they are fit to raise a child. However, the title "The Damaad Test" (The Son-in-law Test) refers to the parallel pressure Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) feels to prove he is a "good son" while also being a "good son-in-law" to Anita’s (Eisha Chopra) visiting parents.

programme.title: Ladkiwale Vs. Ladkewale
programme.desc: While Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) are stuck in the agonizing "waiting period" of the CARA process, the tension shifts to the two sets of parents. The episode highlights that even when everyone agrees on the goal (the grandchild), their different ways of expressing love and anxiety can lead to a hilarious yet deep-seated cultural clash.

programme.title: Are We Ready?
programme.desc: The wait is over: Anita and Nikhil are matched with a child. However, instead of the pure euphoria they expected, they are hit with a wave of intense anxiety. The title "Are We Ready?" reflects the internal crisis the couple faces as they realize their lives are about to change irrevocably—not in nine months, but in a matter of days.

programme.title: What The Future?
programme.desc: The finale begins with the arrival of the moment Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) have spent the entire season preparing for: bringing their adopted daughter home. The episode isn't just about the new arrival, but about how each family member adapts to their "What The Future" role.

programme.title: Comfort Zone
programme.desc: Shaurya struggles with getting recognition for his efforts at work while Sanya debates shifting out of her home. Both of them help each other step out of their comfort zones and grow

programme.title: Time Off
programme.desc: As Shaurya and Sanya shift in together, Sanya takes a gamble at work which impacts both of their lives.

programme.title: Emotion Or Logic
programme.desc: As Shaurya and Sanya deal with the realization of having fallen for each other, they have to prioritize what is more important - emotions or logic?

programme.title: New Roles
programme.desc: Having finally admitted their feelings to each other, Shaurya and Sanya's honeymoon weekend is over and they must get back to reality. With Shaurya up for a promotion and Sanya doubtful about her growth in this company, what is this new couple in for?

programme.title: Milestones
programme.desc: With appraisals around the corner, Shaurya and Sanya brace themselves for the unexpected. Eventually, Shaurya gets his first real lesson in team management and Sanya makes a crucial decision to help her get what she wants.

programme.title: Month-Iversary
programme.desc: To mark 3 months of being together, Shaurya convinces Sanya to organise something for their "monthiversary." However, things begin to get complicated as Shaurya finds himself working directly with Sanya - for the first time since they started dating.

programme.title: Choices
programme.desc: Shaurya eventually ends up at Akhil’s party but to his surprise does not feel like he belongs there. Meanwhile, Ratna invites Sanya to have a drink with her. Sanya still upset about Shaurya lying to her begins to feel better with Ratna and her friends. To her surprise Shaurya shows up there as well to save their monthi-versary. However, things seem to go in the opposite direction soon.

programme.title: Time Off
programme.desc: Shaurya’s presentation does not go as planned and he ends up overpromising samples to the client on a three day deadline. This leads to the team having to work round the clock. Meanwhile, Sanya makes a plan to take a break from work and convinces Shaurya to do go somewhere together. Both Shaurya and Sanya finally spend some quality time with each other but things take a turn when Shaurya gets a call from Vinod.

programme.title: Bajatey Raho
programme.desc: A hilarious con-comedy where a group of people decides to con the cunning businessman who is actually responsible for swindling them.

programme.title: Partner
programme.desc: Bhaskar who is in love with his boss Priya takes tips from "Love Guru" Prem, who believes he knows everything about women and way to their hearts. However, both of them keep failing to woo their ladies.

programme.title: Always Kabhi Kabhi
programme.desc: The film revolves around four characters whose destinies seem to take them on different paths. Somehow, though, they all come together at St.Marks.

programme.title: Buddha Mar Gaya
programme.desc: When LK dies on the night before the IPO opens, the family decides to hide the death until the shares are all sold out.

programme.title: Flesh S1 Ep 1
programme.desc: Two kids runaway from captivity while NRI Zoya meets her mysterious crush. ACP Radha risks her life to save the doomed.

programme.title: Flesh S1 Ep 2
programme.desc: Radha's career is on stake. Zoya goes missing and finds herself in the ruthless world of flesh trade.

programme.title: Flesh S1 Ep 3
programme.desc: A powerful cartel runs the flesh trade with a weirdo in charge. Radha gets strangely involved in Zoya's missing case.

programme.title: Flesh S1 Ep 4
programme.desc: Radha gets a crucial breakthrough in finding Zoya while power tussle is evident in the flesh cartel.

programme.title: Flesh S1 Ep 5
programme.desc: Taj tries everything to tighten his grip on the flesh business. Radha is approached by a strong ally within the force.

programme.title: Flesh S1 Ep 6
programme.desc: While Shekhar and Reba plead for Radha's help, Taj is getting more and more ruthless in his approach.

programme.title: Flesh S1 Ep 7
programme.desc: Shekhar is haunted by the ghosts from his past, which threatens Zoya's future. Taj finally shows his animalistic side.

programme.title: Flesh S1 Ep 8
programme.desc: Radha must face her worst nightmare. While she needs to save Zoya's life, her inner demon is making her weak.

programme.title: Bawri Chhori
programme.desc: Bawri Chhori is a Hindi drama movie of Radhika whose husband leaves her & goes away to London. Radhika waits for her husband to return, but her wait turns into frustration & she decides to go to London to take revenge.

programme.title: Chor Chor Super Chor
programme.desc: Chor Chor Super Chor explores Delhi's grey underbelly in a spleen bursting satirical comedy through two young small-time criminals with different aspirations.

programme.title: Chaar Din Ki Chandni
programme.desc: This comedy-drama with an essence of romance is set in a four-day wedding in Rajasthan.

programme.title: Chalo Dilli
programme.desc: Chalo Dilli is a Hindi comedy movie about Mihika (Lara Dutta) who is an executive banker, who misses her flight to Delhi. Manu (Vinay Pathak), an auto-rickshaw driver tries to help Mihika to reach her destination.

programme.title: Daud
programme.desc: Nandu, a petty thief, is on the run after stealing a mysterious package worth crores of rupees. Not just the police, but the local mafia is after him.

programme.title: Dhama Chaukdi
programme.desc: Four underworld dons - Mani Aiyer from Madras, Pappu Yadav from Bihar, Lallan Pyare from UP and Sanjay Apte from Mumbai - are staunch enemies, having businesses in Mumbai.

programme.title: Shubh Mangal Saavdhan
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about Mudit and Sugandha, whose love is tested by an unexpected personal problem before their wedding.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 1
programme.desc: Kinjal enjoys the new suburban life while Kannan struggles to adjust. A techie Poojari comes over leaving them stunned.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 2
programme.desc: Kalpesh finally finds a smart and reliable help around the store, or at least we hope. Enters Bittu Amritraj!

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 3
programme.desc: Kalpesh wants to get into insurance business, but the problem arrives when he has to clear the Insurance licence exam.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 4
programme.desc: Kalpesh finds that selling insurance is harder than he imagined. Kalpesh decides to aggressively launch his company.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 5
programme.desc: A karaoke machine from the yard-sale rekindles Kalpesh's hidden passion of becoming a Bollywood singer.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 6
programme.desc: Payal and her partner decide to change their ladies salon to unisex. Inauguration goes a bit out of hand.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 7
programme.desc: The family gets on an all-vegetable juice diet plan which Kalpesh and Payal find difficult to follow.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 8
programme.desc: Kinjal starts attending birthing classes along with Kannan. Kalpesh meanwhile introduces the game of cricket to Pankaj.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 9
programme.desc: Kalpesh's house is falling apart with all the house repair work neglected for years, or at least Payal feels so.

programme.title: Filhaal
programme.desc: Rewa is devastated when she comes to know she cannot bear a child. So, her best friend, Sia offers to be the surrogate mother.

programme.title: Haathi Mere Saathi
programme.desc: Watch the bond between humans & elephants with Bandev’s story as he fights for the protection of his ele-friends. Witness the rage on ‘Haathi Mere Saathi’, full movie streaming in Hindi on Eros Now.

programme.title: Dekh Tamasha Dekh
programme.desc: A political satire based on a true story revolving around the search for the religious identity of a poor man crushed under the weight of a politician's hoarding.

programme.title: Four Two Ka One
programme.desc: 2 small-time crooks aspiring to make it big steal a bag which ensures them on a path that leads to them to the most hilarious and unexpected situations!

programme.title: Golmaal In White House
programme.desc: Hai Golmaal In White House is a 1973 Indian Malayalam film, directed by Salar Shaikh. The film stars Rajpal Yadav, Govind Namdeo, Pratima Kazmi, Vijay Raaz, Yashpal Sharma in lead roles.

programme.title: Happy Phirr Bhag Jayegi
programme.desc: Happy gets kidnapped by a group of gangsters, but what happens when they realize that they got the wrong Happy?

programme.title: Hum Tumhare Hain Sanam
programme.desc: A man who loves his wife dearly feels that she is giving undue attention to her friend. As a result, he grows very suspicious resulting in throwing his wife out of the house out of jealousy.

programme.title: Jo Dooba So Paar
programme.desc: Keshu is hardly interested in the routine business of life. His life changes when he meets an Indian-Italian girl who is in India as part of her research.

programme.title: Kaho Na Kaho
programme.desc: Kaho Na Kaho is a 2009 Romantic Drama movie directed & produced by Sanjay Niranjan. The film starred Tarun Khanna, Urvashi, Dinesh Hingoo, Rana Jung Bahadur, Shahbaz Khan in the lead role.

programme.title: Kashmir Daily
programme.desc: Kashmir Daily Story of a Journalist. It highlights the core problems faced by today's generation of Unemployment and Drugs. From the origin of humanity, it has always been a battle between Good and Evil.

programme.title: Chaahat Ek Nasha
programme.desc: Watch four lives get entangled in this tale of passion and obsession.

programme.title: Halahal
programme.desc: The Murder of a college girl morphed into a suicide takes Dr. Shiv on a journey to dig the truth out of his daughter's murder.

programme.title: Khajoor Pe Atke
programme.desc: Devender Sharma fights for his life in the ICU while all his relatives come from across the country to see him, expecting the inevitable. Things turn hilarious when he neither dies nor gets better, leaving his relatives stuck with his wife and son.

programme.title: Ki & Ka
programme.desc: A gender-bender role-reversal romantic drama, Ki & Ka is the story of an ambitious woman and her stay-at-home husband.

programme.title: Mr. White Mr. Black
programme.desc: Gopi is on a mission to fulfil his father's last wish. Little did he know that he's getting into a series of madcap situations!

programme.title: Kiss Kis Ko
programme.desc: Amid rising interest in music groups, a group of young Indian men called Band of Boys set out to perform and build a career. However, facing a market that favors female performers, they must consider adding a woman to the band.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: Koyelaanchal is the story of Saryu Bhan Singh, a ruthless Mafioso and Nisheeth Kumar, an upright District Collector who face off in a most unusual way.

programme.title: Shakal Pe Mat Ja
programme.desc: SPMJ is a story of 4 young boys who get caught up as suspects at the Delhi international airport, on a high alert day. They get caught while capturing an American Airlines aircraft landing on their camera.

programme.title: Gang
programme.desc: Four friends, lured by quick money, form a dangerous gang undertaking criminal activities all the while completely ignoring how it affects their personal relationships.

programme.title: Love Possible
programme.desc: This is a love story of shrewd secretary and Childish boss and her friend who believes in settling down by marrying a rich person.

programme.title: Nh10
programme.desc: On their way to a weekend retreat, Arjun and Meera find their dream vacation turn into a nightmare when they cross path with a dangerous gang.

programme.title: Sunday
programme.desc: Sunday is a Hindi comedy movie about Sehar who is unable to remember a particular Sunday in her life & then is suspected of a murder. A.C.P Rajveer takes up the case.

programme.title: Omkara
programme.desc: In Shakespeare's masterpiece 'Othello' set in modern India, watch how a politically-minded enforcer's misguided trust in his lieutenant leads him to suspect his wife of infidelity.

programme.title: Hota Hai Dil Pyaar Mein Paagal
programme.desc: Two friends fight it out to win the hand of the girl they love - and they will pull all stops to win her heart!

programme.title: Raanjhanaa
programme.desc: A small-town boy, Kundan, needs to break through the class divide to gain acceptance from his childhood love who is in love with big city ideals.

programme.title: Tanu Weds Manu
programme.desc: An NRI doctor Manu falls in love with the free-spirited and loud-mouth Tanu in this blockbuster rom-com starring Kangana Ranaut and R. Madhavan.

programme.title: Teri Meri Kahaani
programme.desc: Three couples from three different eras find love and despite the trials and tribulations they face along the way, destiny seems determined to keep them together.

programme.title: U Me Aur Hum
programme.desc: Ajay and Pia's world comes crashing down when Pia is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. But the two don't give up in the worse of times.

programme.title: Switchh
programme.desc: Stealing, speeding and doing it all in style. Get your heart racing as Vikrant Massey and gang plan the biggest con in #Switchh, now streaming only on #ErosNow.

programme.title: Warning
programme.desc: WARNING is a 3D UNDERWATER film about seven friends stuck in a life-threatening crisis. The lucky ones will die first and the rest will go through the worst nightmares of their lives.

programme.title: Bhoot Returns
programme.desc: Sequel to the horror film Bhoot in which a family moves into a house haunted by a ghost.

programme.title: Manmarziyaan
programme.desc: Manmarziyaan is about a candid Punjabi girl who is madly in love with Vicky. He is commitment phobic & fails to give a long term promise to Rumi. On the other hand, Rumi's parents pressure her for marriage.

programme.title: Munna Michael
programme.desc: India's first ever dance-action film starring Tiger Shroff as a street dancer who turns dance guru for a gangster, Mahindar, played by Nawazuddin Siddiqui!

programme.title: Rockstar
programme.desc: A typical Delhi boy Janardhan chases his dream to be a Rockstar. He falls in love with the most popular girl Heer in Delhi University but it doesn't go smoothly.

programme.title: Prahaar
programme.desc: An idealistic and patriotic army officer is shocked to see that the country he has fought for is going to the dogs.

programme.title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
programme.desc: A battle of good over evil ensues when a righteous cop sets out to rescue a village from the wrath of a cruel ruler.

programme.title: Daud
programme.desc: Nandu, a petty thief, is on the run after stealing a mysterious package worth crores of rupees. Not just the police, but the local mafia is after him.

programme.title: 3g
programme.desc: 3G is a Hindi horror movie about a couple Sam (Neil Nitin Mukesh) & Sheena (Sonal Chauhan) on vacation in Fiji Islands. Sam buys a new 3G phone in Fiji & they start receiving "phantom calls" that changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Aa Dekhen Zara
programme.desc: A photographer has nothing going for him until he inherits a camera with an ability to predict the future but has to ultimately face the dark side of reality.

programme.title: Dhuntaaraa
programme.desc: A thriller for children, Dhuntara is a fun film that traces moments of 4 urban children who discover a new friend in a new place and the mystery that follows.

programme.title: Anwar Ka Ajab Kissa
programme.desc: This is a story of Anwar a clumsy private detective who often gets stuck in hilariously troublesome situations because of his habit of getting involved in the personal lives of his cases. While his life is about following people, he is still in search of himself.

programme.title: Bajatey Raho
programme.desc: A hilarious con-comedy where a group of people decides to con the cunning businessman who is actually responsible for swindling them.

programme.title: Every Sister Should Have A Brother Like Him
programme.desc: A brother who’s protective, fun, annoying, helpful — the kind you’d pick if you could choose. The video highlights the ideal (funny-ideal) brother that makes sisterhood richer.

programme.title: Things Newly Married Couples Do
programme.desc: This video explores the relatable and often humorous experiences of couples after getting married and the honeymoon phase is over. It highlights the changes in dynamics as they transition from being boyfriend/girlfriend to husband and wife.

programme.title: Other People Vs Gujaratis
programme.desc: Stereotypes, pride, and amusing exaggerations around Gujarati culture — how “outsiders” see Gujaratis vs how Gujaratis see themselves. The video plays with accents, food, shopping habits, and family dynamics.

programme.title: If Doctors Could Hear Your Thoughts
programme.desc: A hilarious peek into what would happen if doctors could hear every anxious, dramatic, or random thought their patients have during check-ups.

programme.title: Every School Romance
programme.desc: The video captures the innocent, awkward, and heartwarming moments of school romances. It highlights the shy glances, small gestures, and playful memories that make young love so special.

programme.title: If Exam Subjects Were People
programme.desc: Math, Science, English, and History as human personalities—some annoying, some fun, and all too relatable.

programme.title: College Ke Aakhri Din
programme.desc: The video captures the bittersweet emotions of the last day of college. It highlights the nostalgia, friendships, and heartfelt goodbyes that make this milestone unforgettable.

programme.title: When A Topper Falls In Love With A Backbencher
programme.desc: The academic world collides with romance: one’s always ahead in class, the other’s lagging behind — yet hearts beat anyway. The video shows how opposites in studies find common ground in love.

programme.title: When You Think Everything Is A Sign
programme.desc: You find meaning in random coincidences: the phone rings right when you were thinking of someone, the song you disliked plays, you see an old number—so you start believing the universe is “talking” to you.

programme.title: 8 Ways Your Partner Drives You Mad
programme.desc: A humorous checklist of those little habits and quirks in your significant other that drive you crazy — from hogging the blanket to weird sleeping positions. All done in relatably exaggerated sketches.

programme.title: Every Men's Haircut Ever
programme.desc: From insisting on “just a trim” to miraculously gaining ten inches of hair, this video pokes fun at the clichés every guy goes through at the salon. It captures the disconnect between what men ask for and what they actually get.

programme.title: When You Can't Go Home For Diwali
programme.desc: The video highlights the bittersweet experience of not being able to go home for Diwali, featuring a student who misses her family's celebrations. Despite her initial disappointment, her family surprises her by joining her, making her Diwali special

programme.title: When Your Bff Is Older Than You
programme.desc: The dynamic of having a bestie who’s your mentor, life coach, and chaos partner rolled into one.

programme.title: Story Of Every Average Student
programme.desc: A heartfelt and humorous take on school life for the “average” student: not top of the class, not bottom either—just navigating expectations, grades, fun and the invisible stress of staying “good enough”.

programme.title: Thoughts Babies Have
programme.desc: In a baby’s world: “Why am I small? What’s that giant thing called a toy? Where’s my milk again?” — the video imagines the simple but curious internal tongue of a baby. It’s adorable and funny at the same time.

programme.title: Things Single Women Have To Deal With
programme.desc: The video humorously shows the everyday struggles single women face. It highlights societal questions, unwanted advice, and the funny situations that come with being single.

programme.title: When You Are An Only Child
programme.desc: The perks (undivided attention, full bed) and pangs (no sibling backup, solitude) of being an only child — all wrapped in funny, bittersweet moments. It’s a tribute to a life of solo siblinghood.

programme.title: When Your Bff Gets Dumped
programme.desc: A relatable take on post-breakup friendship — from emotional support and venting sessions to plotting revenge and ice cream-fueled pep talks.

programme.title: Every Make-Up Lover Ever
programme.desc: From obsessing over blending brushes to dramatic contour fails—this one’s for every beauty enthusiast.

programme.title: Things Fathers Do (father's Day Special)
programme.desc: A heartfelt yet funny look at the quirks, silent sacrifices and the unspoken ways fathers show up — from fixing things to just being there. The video celebrates dads in their unique, often unnoticed style.

programme.title: When Your Sibling Moves Away (rakhi Special)
programme.desc: On the occasion of Rakhi, the bittersweet parting: your sibling’s move away triggers both nostalgia and the awkward new dynamic when you’re no longer under the same roof.

programme.title: Why Grandparents Are The Best
programme.desc: From secret treats to bedtime stories and unconditional love, this one’s a warm hug in video form.

programme.title: When Your Partner Cheats On You
programme.desc: The emotional roller-coaster of discovering infidelity: the trust shattered, the shock, the confrontation and the difficult decision of what comes next. Heart-break meets self-reflection.

programme.title: Savage Comebacks Every Bride Needs
programme.desc: A newly-wed bride’s toolkit of witty one-liners and bold responses for those aunties, uncles and relatives. The video plays up the idea of being classy but savage when family dramas hit.

programme.title: When You Don't Like Socialising
programme.desc: The introvert’s anthem—dodging parties, small talk, and pretending to be busy when someone says “Let’s hang out!”

programme.title: Other Students Vs Me
programme.desc: The video humorously contrasts the habits and achievements of “other students” with your own. It highlights the funny struggles, procrastination, and relatable moments of trying to keep up in school or college.

programme.title: Sibling Wars Badi Behen Vs Choti Behen
programme.desc: The older-sister vs younger-sister saga: authority battles, petty fights, secret changing-room bans, and a surprising amount of caring behind the theatrics.

programme.title: When A Delhi Boy Falls For A Mumbai Girl
programme.desc: Culture-clash, language mishaps, food-fights and the long-distance jokes: a Delhi boy navigating the Mumbai way of life while falling for a girl who lives it.

programme.title: If You Could Hear Your Crush's Thoughts
programme.desc: This video comically explores the scenarios that unfold if you could hear your crush's thoughts. It highlights the internal monologues, often contrasting with their outward actions, providing a humorous look at the anxieties and desires involved in a crush.

programme.title: Story Of Every Ca
programme.desc: The journey of a Chartered Accountant aspirant — sleepless nights, endless revisions, social life sacrificed, and pressure from family & society. It portrays CA life as a tough balancing act between dreams and stress.

programme.title: Wedding Conversations With Mom
programme.desc: Navigating budgets, guest lists, rituals, outfit choices and mom’s expectations: every exchange becomes a mini-negotiation. The video showcases the wait, the stress, and the sweet chaos of wedding-planning talks with mom.

programme.title: If You Worked In Office Like You Work From Home
programme.desc: The video imagines how chaotic and unprofessional it would be if people behaved in an office the same way they do while working from home. It highlights the funny contrasts between remote work habits and real office etiquette.

programme.title: When You Date A Food Lover
programme.desc: Dates revolve around food, arguments over “where to eat,” and the constant temptation to steal bites from your partner’s plate.

programme.title: Filtercopy | Nani Ka Ghar | नानी का घर
programme.desc: A warm nostalgic trip to Grandma’s house—endless food, pampering, cousins, and that special comfort you can’t find anywhere else.

programme.title: Other Couples Vs Us
programme.desc: The video humorously contrasts idealized, picture-perfect couples with the messy, realistic dynamics of everyday relationships. It highlights the funny, imperfect moments that make love authentic and relatable.

programme.title: When Your Best Friend Leaves Office
programme.desc: When your office buddy moves on: the swap from daily gossip sessions and lunch-huddles to suddenly being solo, and the quiet realisation of how much they held up your workday.

programme.title: The Son-In-Law You Deserve
programme.desc: A comedic take on the “perfect” damaad every Indian parent dreams of—respectful, helpful, responsible. But real-life sons-in-law rarely fit this mythical description.

programme.title: Lockdown: Beginning Vs Now
programme.desc: The shift from “I’ll be productive” optimism to pajama-all-day acceptance—lockdown fatigue captured hilariously.

programme.title: When You Go Home After A Long Time
programme.desc: The comfort of maa ke haath ka khana, nosy relatives, and the joy of rediscovering your childhood bedroom.

programme.title: When Your Bff Is A Lifesaver

programme.title: Pff-Lahoriye
programme.desc: Set in present-day Punjab, the film is a poignant cross-border love story centered on Kikkar Singh (Amrinder Gill), a Sikh man from an Indian border village, and Ameeran Khan (Sargun Mehta), a Muslim woman from Lahore, Pakistan. While working near the Indo-Pak border, Kikkar falls in love with Ameeran, leading to a journey of navigating cultural, political, and emotional hurdles. The film explores themes of love transcending physical borders, the enduring pain of the 1947 partition, and the shared heritage of Punjabis on both sides.

Hosted by Saira, Anmol Aulakh and Gurjeet Singh, the show features a diverse range of talent competing for the coveted title. Renowned music directors Gurmeet Singh and Jaidev Kumar (Music Director) along with celebrated singer Jyotika Tangri, serve as the esteemed judges, guiding contestants on a musical journey. Each episode is a celebration of talent, emotion, and the magic of Punjabi music.

programme.title: Maa Da Daaj
programme.desc: Nimrat and Sartaaj share a happy life until she seeks divorce. A bank copy from her dowry, given by her mother, changes everything, bringing a twist that reshapes their relationship.

programme.title: Jurm Te Jazbaat
programme.desc: This crime thriller anthology series, hosted by Ronit Roy, explores the dark side of human nature—where extreme emotions such as greed, jealousy, lust, and obsession spiral into shocking crimes. Each episode presents a standalone, fast-paced narrative inspired by passion-driven murders and intense criminal mysteries. Through gripping dramatization and Ronit Roy’s commanding narration, the series dissects the emotional triggers that push ordinary individuals toward extraordinary acts of violence. The focus goes beyond the crime itself, uncovering the psychological conflicts and fatal decisions that lead to irreversible consequences.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today’s Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it’s party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what’s trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Mitti De Bol
programme.desc: Bhinder returns from America but feels hurt when his father doesn’t welcome him warmly. Mitti De Bol explores the emotional bond between a father and son, shaped by pain, distance, and separation.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit Devotional Songs
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Live Gurbani From Sachkhand Sri Harmandir Sahib, Amritsar
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life’s challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: Confused about the difference between white and brown sugar? Mugdha Pradhan clears the air! Learn how they're made, their nutritional value, and why one might be slightly better than the other. But that's not all! Discover healthier alternatives to satisfy your sweet tooth without the guilt. This video is your go-to guide for making informed choices.

programme.title: Celebrity Fitness Secrets-Richa Chadha
programme.desc: Discover the secrets behind Richa Chadha's diet and fitness regime! In this video, we delve into her balanced diet plan, which includes nutrient-rich foods that fuel her body and promote overall wellness. We also explore her fitness routine to keep her in top shape. Join us as we break down Richa's healthy lifestyle habits that contribute to her incredible physique and vibrant health. Whether you're looking for diet tips, workout inspiration, or a holistic approach to fitness, this video has got you covered!

programme.title: Celebrity Fitness Secrets-Milind Soman
programme.desc: In this video, we explore the fitness and diet routine of Milind Soman, renowned for his incredible fitness and healthy lifestyle. We delve into his daily workout regimen, which includes running daily, swimming, cycling, & exercises. Additionally, we discuss his diet plan, emphasizing fresh fruits, less processed, and simple homemade meals. Milind Soman advocates for a balanced and healthy lifestyle, demonstrating that fitness extends beyond exercise to include a well-rounded approach to daily living. Join us for insights and tips to stay fit and healthy, inspired by Milind Soman’s regimen.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 03 | Ideal Body Fat Percentage and How to Maintain it
programme.desc: Ever wondered what's the perfect amount of fat your body should have? Mugdha Pradhan breaks it down for you in simple terms. She explains why a number on the scale isn't everything and how body fat percentage truly matters. Learn about the ideal range for your health and fitness goals. Watch now to understand your body better!

programme.title: Role of Medicinal Plants In Mental Health & WellBeing I Sehat Club Community
programme.desc: The two-day seminar on the "Role of Medicinal Plants in Mental Health & Wellbeing," organized by Pragyata Foundation in collaboration with the Ministry of AYUSH, successfully concluded. The event delved into the profound impact of medicinal plants on mental health, featuring insights from leading experts in Ayurveda and holistic wellness. OnlyMyHealth, digital media partner, provided exclusive coverage and key takeaways from the seminar. This informative event offered a deeper understanding of how nature’s remedies can support mental well-being.

programme.title: Chocolate Day EP 01 | How to Make Tasty and Healthy Dark Chocolate Nut & Seed Bar
programme.desc: In this video, we're showing you how to make homemade Dark Chocolate Nut & Seed Bars that are not only tasty but also packed with health benefits. Perfect for a snack or a dessert, these bars are easy to make and sure to satisfy your chocolate cravings. These bars are perfect for a quick snack, a boost of energy, or a sweet treat that you can feel good about.

programme.title: Ayurveda with Dimple Jangda Ep 03 - Reasons why Celebs are turning to Ayurveda
programme.desc: In this video, we delve into the reasons why more and more people are turning to Ayurveda for their health and wellness needs. Join Dimple Jangda, a renowned Ayurveda expert, as she explains the benefits of this ancient holistic system. Discover how Ayurveda addresses the root causes of health issues, promotes natural healing, and offers personalized treatments based on individual body types (doshas). Learn about the various ways Ayurveda can improve your physical, mental, and emotional well-being. Watch this video to understand the growing popularity of Ayurveda and how it can transform your life.

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 09 - Controlling PCOD and PCOS Through Diet
programme.desc:
In this video, of Wellness Vardaan, we explore effective dietary strategies to manage and control PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome) and PCOD (Polycystic Ovarian Disease). These common health issues affect many women worldwide, but with the right diet, you can alleviate symptoms and take control of your health.
Our coach, Vidhi Chawla shares essential foods to include in your diet to balance hormones, reduce inflammation, and maintain a healthy weight, as well as common foods and ingredients that should be limited or avoided.

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 15 - Nutritious options for Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner
programme.desc: Say goodbye to the worry of healthy and tasty meals throughout the day! In this video, Vidhi Chawla shares quick and easy nutritious options for Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner that will keep you healthy and energized all day long. Whether you're in a rush or have some extra time, these tips will help you enjoy healthy eating effortlessly. So, join us and make your meals a true 'Wellness Vardaan'.

programme.title: Celebrity Fitness Secrets-Shamita Shetty
programme.desc: In this video, we reveal Shamita Shetty's diet and fitness mantra that keeps her looking fit and healthy. Learn how the actress stays in shape, the foods she eats, and her workout routine. From simple diet tips to her fitness secrets, discover how you can follow a healthy lifestyle like Shamita. Watch the video for easy and effective fitness tips you can include in your daily life!

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 05 | Are Natural Sugars in Fruits Harmful
programme.desc: Are natural sugar present in fruits harmful. Watch Mugdha Pradhan break the myth and share insights if natural sugar present in fruits harmful and what is the right way to consume fruits.

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 12 - Importance of Checking Food Labels and Nutrition Facts Part 1
programme.desc: Do you know why it's essential to read the Food Labels & Nutrition Facts on packaged foods? Watch this video featuring renowned nutritionist Vidhi Chawla, who will explain how understanding these labels can help us make healthier food choices for our well-being.

programme.title: Understanding Gallbladder Stones Causes, Symptoms & Treatment Explained
programme.desc: Gallbladder stones, or gallstones, are a common yet often misunderstood health issue. In this video, we break down everything you need to know about gallstones, including what causes them, the symptoms to watch out for, and the treatment options available. Whether you're dealing with gallstones or just want to learn more, this video will provide you with clear, easy-to-understand information. Stay informed and take control of your health.

programme.title: Ayurveda with Dimple Jangda Ep 10 - How you can manage PCOD and PCOS using Ayurvedic remedies
programme.desc: Ayurveda expert Dimple Jangda shares how you can manage PCOD and PCOS using Ayurvedic remedies. Dimple explains how to balance your hormones naturally, make lifestyle changes, and improve your health through proper nutrition. Discover the most effective ways to combat PCOD and PCOS with Ayurvedic herbs, yoga, and home remedies.

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 14 - How to Stay Healthy in Busy Life - Part 1
programme.desc: In today's fast-paced world, maintaining a healthy lifestyle can be challenging. In this insightful video podcast, we're joined by renowned dietitian and health coach, Vidhi Chawla, who shares practical tips and strategies to help you stay healthy amidst a busy life. From smart meal planning to quick and nutritious food choices, Vidhi offers expert advice on how to balance your diet and wellness, even with a hectic schedule. Whether you're a working professional, a student, or juggling multiple responsibilities, this episode is packed with actionable insights to help you prioritize your health. Don't miss out on these essential tips to nourish your body and mind in the hustle of everyday life!

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 04 - Gut-Adopt 80-20 Formula to Keep our Bodies 2nd Brain Healthy
programme.desc: Do you know that our gut is the second brain of our body? A healthy gut is extremely important for our overall health. In this video we will tell you how you can keep your gut healthy and improve the quality of your life by adopting 80-20 Formula.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 01 | How to Prepare Diet Chart
programme.desc: Join Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan in this insightful video as she guides you through the process of creating your own personalized diet plan. Learn how to identify your unique health goals and dietary needs, choose the right foods for your body type and lifestyle, and develop a balanced meal plan that is both effective and sustainable. Mugdha’s expert tips will help you navigate grocery shopping, meal prepping, and monitoring your progress to ensure you stay on track. Whether you're aiming to lose weight, boost your energy, or improve overall health, this video provides practical and scientific advice to help you take control of your nutrition.

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 02 - Foods To Avoid For A Healthy Heart
programme.desc: Discover the surprising everyday foods that might be harming your heart health and learn healthier alternatives to incorporate into your diet. Vidhi breaks down complex nutritional information into easy-to-understand tips, ensuring you make informed choices for a stronger, healthier heart.

programme.title: Celebrity Fitness Secrets-Malaika Arora
programme.desc: Join us in this episode of our Bollywood Celebrity Fitness Series as we delve into the fitness regime of the stunning Malaika Arora. Known for her enviable physique and dedication to health, Malaika shares her secrets to staying fit and fabulous.

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 08 - Natural Detox VS Detox Diets - Which one to Choose?
programme.desc: In the video "Natural Detox VS Detox Diets - Which One to Choose?" we will explain the differences between natural detox methods and detox diets, and help you decide which one might be better for you. We will discuss the benefits of natural detox, highlighting its safe and natural approach. Additionally, we will examine how detox diets work, along with their potential advantages and drawbacks. By the end of the video, you will have a clear understanding of which option is best suited to your lifestyle and health goals.

programme.title: Yummy! Hot Cross Buns
programme.desc: From making yummy hot cross buns for their parents, Learn and enjoy other famous Nursery Rhymes and Songs

programme.title: Goals
programme.desc: As Meera, our pretty in pink protagonist comes back to Bombay after spending several months apart from her beau Ranbir, the circumstances force them to evaluate the basis of their relationship. This film is a deep dive into a young adult's core problems of emotional dishonesty and preference of style over substance.

programme.title: Dubki
programme.desc: Dubki is a story based on a true incident of a female constable in male-dominated law enforcement. Despite being a tough and dominant constable at the Lalkurti police station, Ganga Yadav was troubled several times by SHO Durgesh Mishra. Ganga complained about it to the IPS officer and asked for a transfer; however, he refused to help her. The female constable was left with no other choice but to take justice into her own hands.

programme.title: Firni
programme.desc: The next-door neighbors are having a fight and they send their rude 14-year-old daughter Firni to keep her busy.

programme.title: Dwand
programme.desc: Ruby, a lower-middle-class girl was made to believe that she is beautiful, intelligent, and different and that she deserves a worthy husband. She completed her studies and wanted to be a career girl. However, the marriage happened contrary to her expectations with a traditional man Vivek of the similar lower middle-class strata. After giving birth to a girl child she revolted and joined an advertising company to shape up her career. Here begins the nightmare.

programme.title: Duty
