programme.desc: London-based Monica rushes to India after her brother's death, discovering his widow is involved with an escaped convict.

programme.title: Amrit
programme.desc: A corrupt policeman and greedy builder team up to seize land from Yadav, a Mumbai milk vendor with a cattle farm. Will they succeed?

programme.title: Dharam Veer
programme.desc: CBI officer Suraj learns childhood friend Yash and his father run an illegal business. Assigned to investigate, Suraj decides to convince Yash to change his ways.

programme.title: Namak Halaal
programme.desc: Simpleton Kallu is falsely imprisoned by Shahani Seth, learning criminal ways from hardened inmates. He escapes, determined to destroy Shahani.

programme.title: Mera Damad
programme.desc: Dutiful Jai meets his potential wife in the wrong village. He falls for Kimi, the eccentric mansion-owner's daughter. How will Jai tell his father, and how will families react?

programme.title: Love Love Love
programme.desc: Vijay and Laxmi live happily with Vijay's stepbrother Ravi and his wife Lalita. Property issues and misunderstandings soon threaten to separate them all.

programme.title: I M 24
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Sapna falls for patient Karan. He proposes when normal, but she disapproves. What's the reason?

programme.title: Zulmi
programme.desc: A young man seeks to avenge his sister's death but learns that his quarry is under protection of his own mentor.

programme.title: Jeans
programme.desc: Rejected aspiring actor turns to drink & women. His life collapses when he contracts STD. Will he find the will to live?

programme.title: Bhavnao Ko Samjho
programme.desc: Smooth con-artist Ashok wants to be honest after falling for Seema. When his past is exposed, he must win her back and protect her from past ghosts.

programme.title: Daata
programme.desc: Kundan loses his father and sister to dowry injustice. Seeking revenge, he commits murder, and his life spirals downwards.

programme.title: Naina
programme.desc: Naina loses eyesight in a car accident. Years later, a corneal transplant gives her vision, but she sees hallucinations and another's reflection. A psychiatrist investigates, leading to a village where the donor's curse endangers her.

programme.title: Maachis
programme.desc: Orphaned Mangla's arranged marriage to blind Anand occurs after her lover betrays her. Initially hesitant, she falls for Anand, but he drives her out upon learning of her ex.

programme.title: Encounter: The Killing
programme.desc: A guilt-stricken cop accidentally shoots a mobster. He searches for the parents who never claimed the body.

programme.title: Sp Chauhan: A Struggling Man
programme.desc: This biopic traces Thakur Satpal Chauhan's journey, a Haryana social worker who bravely promoted women's empowerment & an alcohol-free society.

programme.title: Hum Hain Lajawaab
programme.desc: Married Vishwam, son of a powerful landlord, is obsessed with schoolmaster's wife Sushila and kidnaps her.

programme.title: Toh Baat Pakki
programme.desc: An aspiring actress becomes a bar dancer when her acting career fails. A man offers to help her. Will her dream of making it big in Mumbai ever come true?

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Writer Ajay shares a script. A robbery occurs, matching his plot. Accused, Ajay must prove his innocence.

programme.title: Aflatoon
programme.desc: To be a millionaire, Raja poses as a professor, luring rich heiress Pooja. Trouble starts when he's blamed for crimes by his evil lookalike Rocky.

programme.title: Alag He Is Different He Is Alone
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy from a basement, gets psychic powers after his father's death. A scientist abducts him for experiments.

programme.title: Jd_hindi
programme.desc: Six call-center employees juggle personal lives and endless calls. An unusual caller offers them a chance to turn their lives around.

programme.title: Bemisal

programme.title: Maharathi
programme.desc: After Jai Singh's suicide, his chauffeur Subhash plots to win insurance money. He allies with Jai's wife to make the suicide appear a planned murder.

programme.title: The Great Gambler
programme.desc: Twins Kishan and Kanhaiya swap identities. Kanhaiya helps Kishan woo his love and eliminate rivals, but rowdy Bijli, who loves Kishan, tries to foil their plans.

programme.title: Guns Of Banaras
programme.desc: Guddu's lucky bike is stolen. While searching, he gets entangled in crime, discovering his bike is used for drug transport.

programme.title: Kuchh Meetha Ho Jaye
programme.desc: Terminally ill Ravi frames himself for murder for family reward. Cured, he escapes police to find the real killer and clear his name. Will he succeed?

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Orphaned in the jungle, Tarzan saves explorer Ruby, and they fall in love. When Ruby's troupe finds them, they capture Tarzan for a circus.

programme.title: Neel Kamal
programme.desc: Ram falls for sleepwalking Sita, later realizing her sleepwalking hides dark secrets from a past life.

programme.title: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Ayesha writes a novel about her prostitution journey, trying to persuade sister Anu to let go of her past and start fresh.

programme.title: Souten

programme.title: Ghar Ghar Ki Kahani

programme.title: Charanon Ki Saugandh
programme.desc: Childless Rukhsar convinces friend Nagma to marry her husband. Nagma's conniving uncle and aunt create misunderstandings. Will Rukhsar's marriage crumble?

programme.title: Gupt The Hidden Truth
programme.desc: Sahil Sinha loves Isha but his father insists on an arranged marriage. After an argument, Jaisingh dies. Sahil is blamed, jailed, and escapes to find the real killer.

programme.title: Gair Kaanooni
programme.desc: Police officers Karan and Ali investigate a colleague's murder. Karan protects Anjali, a bar dancer and key witness. His falling for her compromises his objectivity.

programme.title: Avtaar
programme.desc: Retired mechanic Avtaar and his wife are swindled out of their home by sons. Avtaar decides to rebuild a successful business with his wife and loyal servant Sewak's support.

programme.title: Prem Geet
programme.desc: Richest man Vikrant Raina's daughter is kidnapped. The kidnapper demands he complete deadly tasks to settle an old score, not money.

programme.title: Blue Mountains

programme.title: Nishant
programme.desc: Doctor Aryan and nurse Annie care for an old man. Aryan marries his granddaughter Nikita to embezzle wealth, but she discovers their plan.

programme.title: Mandi
programme.desc: Durga's callous mother-in-law runs a strict household. Durga must teach her humility and win her heart to ease life.

programme.title: Masoom

programme.title: Born To Fly
programme.desc: Two American F-35 Lightning II fighters enter Chinese airspace and cause havoc near the coast. Flying at supersonic speeds, the F-35s create sonic booms that damage an oil refinery and fishing boats. Box office smash hit & multiple award winner Born to Fly comes to life with special operations team headed by elite pilots who face death and challenge the limits of the sky and themselves.

programme.title: Sky Sharks
programme.desc: A team of geologists uncover an old Nazi warship still intact where dark experiments had occurred. In order to conquer the world, the Nazis created rocket-powered sharks whose pilots are genetically mutated with supernatural powers.

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: Consecration
programme.desc: After the alleged suicide of her priest brother, Grace travels to the remote Scottish convent. As she explores the wild cliffs and windswept beaches nearby, she uncovers what really happened with the help of Vatican priest, not only the murder but a disturbing truth about her own past which brings long-buried trauma to the surface.

programme.title: The Free Fall
programme.desc: The Free Fall is a deeply personal horror thriller, a mind bending pressure cooker that constantly challenges us, hurling us towards one of the most shocking cinematic reveals imaginable.

programme.title: The Deep Dark
programme.desc: 1956, northern France. When a group of miners are forced to take a professor underground with them for samples in the depths of a coal mine, they quickly realize that they are not alone and discover a crypt from another time, unknowingly waking up a bloodthirsty creature. One watchword: survival.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: Nefarious
programme.desc: A convicted serial killer on day of his scheduled execution gets a last minute court-ordered psychiatric evaluation. The killer surprises the psychiatrist with his claim that he is a demon who wants the execution to go forward and claims that before their brief tie together is over, the doctor will commit three murders by day's end

programme.title: Untraceable
programme.desc: A FBI secret service agent, gets caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a serial killer who knows that people will log onto an "untraceable" website where he conducts violent and painful murders LIVE on the net.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Bad Samaritan is a terrifying thriller of two young car valets who use their business as a front to burglarize houses of customers while they eat. Their lives are turned upside down when they rob the home of a demented serial killer.

programme.title: Wrecker
programme.desc: Two beautiful young women taking a trip through the countryside, are terrorized by an unknown driver trying to run them down in a heavy duty tow truck.

programme.title: Cold Skin
programme.desc: In 1914, a young man arrives at a remote island near the Antarctic Circle to take the post of weather observer only to find himself trapped in a watchtower besieged by deadly creatures which live in hiding on the island.

programme.title: Rebel
programme.desc: A young man leaves Belgium to help war victims in Syria, but is forced to join an armed group and is left stranded in AL Raqqa. While at home his little brother becomes easy prey for jihadi recruiters. The only thing their mother has left with is to protect: her Son.

programme.title: Death Of Me
programme.desc: A couple vacationing on a Thai island wakes with no memory and a chilling video showing one killing the other. Caught in black magic and mystery, they must uncover the truth—was she spared, or did nature demand a sacrifice?

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: THE HURT LOCKER is an intense portrayal of elite soldiers who have one of the most dangerous jobs in the world: disarming bombs during the Iraq War.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: Every 23rd spring for 23days, it gets to eat…Stranded on a lonely road, a school bus full of high school players must defend themselves from the Creeper, the winged, flesh-eating terror.

programme.title: Orphan First Kill
programme.desc: After orchestrating a brilliant escape from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Esther travels to America by impersonating the missing daughter of a wealthy family. Yet, an unexpected twist arises that pits her against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous "child" at any cost.

programme.title: Jurassic Hunt
programme.desc: In this pulse-pounding Creature thriller, female adventurer Parker joins a crew of male trophy hunters in a remote wilderness park. Their goal: slaughter genetically recreated dinosaurs & work together to evade the giant human-hungry creatures.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Hatching
programme.desc: In the most terrifying creature feature Hatching is a story about lovelessness that creates a monster. After finding a wounded bird in the woods, a 12 year old brings its strange egg home, she hides it and keeps it warm until it hatches. The creature that emerges becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare. What has she been hatching under everyone's noses that shocks them all?

programme.title: The Descent
programme.desc: Six girlfriends, a deep cave expedition going horribly wrong, suffocating miles under the surface of Earth, breed of predators smells their skin.

programme.title: Baal Krishna

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Netrasur, an asur descended from Bhasmasur, terrorizes Brindavan by shrinking its residents and threatening Krishna with ash-turning powers inherited from a dangerous divine boon. With help from Yaksh Kumaar, Krishna protects his friends and prioritizes their safety, even as Netrasur sets traps and demands obedience. Parallel intrigues unfold—Kansa schemes to revive Bhasmasur using sacred ashes, prophecies surrounding Prema’s marriage expose greed and destiny manipulation, and Shiva warns of cosmic imbalance without directly intervening. Through wit and deception, Krishna turns Netrasur’s own power against him, restoring all victims and reestablishing harmony in Brindavan. Festivities resume amid Diwali preparations, moral lessons on greed and reform are reinforced through a theft subplot, and while peace returns, unresolved conspiracies foreshadow greater trials ahead.

programme.title: Tomorrow Will Be Better
programme.desc: Czech freestyle motocross star Libor Podmol is proof that the wildest dreams come true. In January, 2010 he flies to the US, buys a Suzuki 250 two-stroke, becomes 6 times world champ and signs a sponsorship deal with Rockstar Energy.

programme.title: California Republic
programme.desc: No other place offers such endless freedom while fueling surfing's evolution. California's blue skies, green waters, and landscapes inspire millions worldwide and shape global culture.

programme.title: Peace And Left Ii
programme.desc: A Basque freesurfer documents a five-month journey through Indonesia, traveling with family, friends, and alone, capturing his surf adventure on camera.

programme.title: All Or Nothing
programme.desc: A self-supported project celebrating two-wheel sports, filmed across Europe, featuring young talents and world-class riders in MTB, trials, BMX, and motorsports.

programme.title: Because
programme.desc: A high-end freeski documentary following 22 professional athletes across record snowfall winters, facing deep powder, massive cliffs, and extreme expeditions, while sharing their ambition, discipline, and drive to reach the next level of their careers.

programme.title: Begging For Change
programme.desc: This movie is about the lives of strange and exhilarating men, begging for change, and living a life that is fast, cheap, and affordable. All the things that make up a great ski movie

programme.title: Chaiyo Premiere Tour
programme.desc: A skate documentary following a 10-day tour across Thailand, featuring demos and premieres in several cities, capturing the energy of local skate scenes and the passion of skaters coming together to celebrate.

programme.title: Dalua Downhill
programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.

programme.title: Dalua Downhill
programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.
